name: Ancient Walrus 24
author: ke1221
description: Rounded white button that responds while pressed down.
howItWorks:
While pressed, text color changes from #090909 to #666, box-shadow becomes inset 4px 4px 12px #c5c5c5,
             inset -4px -4px 12px #ffffff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ancient Walrus 24</title>
<style>
/* Ancient Walrus 24 by ke1221 — https://uiverse.io/ke1221/ancient-walrus-24 */
button {
 color: #090909;
 padding: 0.7em 1.7em;
 font-size: 18px;
 border-radius: 0.5em;
 background: #e8e8e8;
 border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
 transition: all .3s;
 box-shadow: 6px 6px 12px #c5c5c5,
             -6px -6px 12px #ffffff;
}

button:active {
 color: #666;
 box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 12px #c5c5c5,
             inset -4px -4px 12px #ffffff;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Click me
</button>

</body>
</html>
